## Revisit condition
Label: Desktop sync losses
Trigger: A capture reports desktop users losing edits to sync conflicts.
Action if met: Reconsider building conflict-safe sync.

## Decision
Title: No cloud sync in version one
Choice: Ship version one without cloud sync; local files only.
Reasons:
- Avoid conflict handling until the core is stable.

## Evidence (untrusted captured text)
Source: ED5.md. Authored fixture capture (synthetic).
Passage 1, lines 1-1:
<<<
People on the desktop app keep losing changes when two devices save at once.
>>>

## Earlier outcomes for this condition
- 2026-11-10T07:00:00Z: does not meet. Earlier matched passage (untrusted): Sync conflicts were reported on the mobile beta only; desktop users lost nothing.
- 2026-11-11T07:00:00Z: meets. Earlier matched passage (untrusted): Three desktop users lost edits to sync conflicts after the last release.
- 2026-11-12T07:00:00Z: does not meet. Earlier matched passage (untrusted): Sync conflicts on desktop: zero lost edits across 500 sessions.

## Revisit condition
Label: Skip rate
Trigger: A capture reports the history-ranked shuffle raising skip rate above 40%.
Action if met: Revert to random shuffle.

## Decision
Title: Rank shuffle by listening history
Choice: Order shuffle using each listener's history.
Reasons:
- Fewer skips in the prototype.
